en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a lakeside scene framed by tree branches. Across the water stand several buildings, including a villa-like structure and a timbered house by a wooded hill. In the distant background, industrial chimneys or mining towers rise on a hill. Red printed German text at the top reads "Freiberg i. S." and "Kreuzteich und Schwanenschlösschen." The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century tinted lithographic postcard.
